_comment: The AI gateway's own settings, managed from the AI page. Providers live in config/credentials/ai_providers.json; this holds only the listen port and the client keys devices authenticate with. Rendered into CLIProxyAPI's YAML by the panel — never edit the generated file.
_comment_fields: Each client key: id (panel-assigned), name (the device or person it is for), key_sealed (the key itself, sealed under the vault's data key, so this file carries no key material), created_at. The list ships empty; the panel fills it, and a record without a seal is dropped on load.
